title: Stem Cell Therapy

content:
South Florida Bone Marrow/Stem Cell Transplant Institute.

The power of a patient’s own immune system holds the key to wellness and critical illness care.  Dr. Dipnarine Maharaj of the South Florida Bone Marrow/Stem Cell Transplant Institute has made advanced programs available to Hippocrates guests to utilize their own adult stem cells for disease treatment.  Guests interested in advanced wellness programs will have the opportunity to collect and store their stem cells long term to boost their immune system in the future.  For more information please contact Dr. Paul at Hippocrates Wellness tel: 561-471-8876
